wages.text: Torres voted for the PRO Act and celebrated its strengthening of unions and workers' right to organize.
wages.quote: The PRO Act would preempt the Orwellian right-to-work laws so that union organizing is given the freedom to flourish everywhere in the United States.

trade.text: Torres has repeatedly attacked Trump's tariffs as a tax that harms American manufacturing and consumers.
trade.quote: The Trump tariff regime is a triple tax on American manufacturing: a U.S. tax on the components, a U.S. tax on the end product, and a retaliatory foreign tax on American exports.

debt.text: Torres introduced legislation to protect seniors' access to traditional Medicare and defends the program's role.
debt.quote: Medicare is how millions of seniors and retirees are able to go to the doctor, get the care they need, and live decent, dignified, and healthy lives.

housing.text: Introducing the ASAP Housing Act, Torres argued the way to lower housing costs is to expand the supply of housing.
housing.quote: The best way to cap the cost of housing is to uncap the volume of housing.

immigration.text: Torres condemned ICE deportations and fought the removal of a DACA beneficiary from his district.
immigration.quote: the vile anti-immigrant ideology of Donald Trump remains dominant at ICE, which is a soulless deportation machine that separates families and savages communities without regard for the human cost.

guns.text: Torres introduced federal legislation banning ghost guns and expanding gun-free school zones to curb gun violence.
guns.quote: We do not have to live in a world where Americans and especially children routinely fall victim to mass murder in the very places where they're supposed to be safe.

abortion.text: Torres says he will fight in Congress to protect the right to abortion.
abortion.quote: I believe in the right to choose how a person controls their own body, and will fight in Congress to ensure that right isn't eroded.

health.text: Torres said he backs universal health care including the availability of Medicare for all.
health.quote: I support Universal Healthcare including the availability of Medicare for all.

energy.text: Torres frames expanding electric-vehicle infrastructure as part of combating the climate crisis.
energy.quote: As we work to electrify the streets of New York City and combat the climate crisis
